target.note: Verify final deployment privileges at LP-9 after the remaining lanes land.

responsibilities.LP-12: Separate command-table custody and bound ledger writes, and remove redundant credential access from the binding-store owner.
responsibilities.LP-9: Final deployment catalogue and refusal proof.

after.downstream: LP-11 keeps scoped session lookup. The binding-store owner retains only four practice-session columns for the private job-proof reader. Four ledger routines retain their installed definitions and EXECUTE callers under the narrow money owner. The command writer retains only its required table and column grants.

before.title: Roles, ownership, schemas, defaults and system entry points
before.description: jobguard_migration owns every application table, view and SECURITY DEFINER routine; the runtime, identity, infrastructure and shadow roles are NOINHERIT with no memberships; PUBLIC holds PostgreSQL default privileges (database CONNECT and TEMPORARY, language and type USAGE, function EXECUTE on routines without an explicit ACL); no explicit default privileges exist; the runtime login can execute a few PostgreSQL system functions that enforce their own role checks.

responsibilities.LP-12: new binding, command, audit and money chokepoints get narrower owners; no migration-role inheritance or unrestricted helper defeats the boundary
responsibilities.LP-9: final deployment-representative catalogue run and bounded completion claim

after.title: Roles, ownership, schemas, defaults and system entry points
after.description: jobguard_migration owns every application table, view and SECURITY DEFINER routine; the runtime, identity, infrastructure and shadow roles are NOINHERIT with no memberships; PUBLIC holds PostgreSQL default privileges (database CONNECT and TEMPORARY, language and type USAGE, function EXECUTE on routines without an explicit ACL); no explicit default privileges exist; the runtime login can execute a few PostgreSQL system functions that enforce their own role checks. LP-12 separates command-table custody, removes redundant binding-store credential access and moves four bound ledger routines to jobguard_money_owner.

responsibilities.LP-12: new binding, command, audit and money chokepoints get narrower owners; no migration-role inheritance or unrestricted helper defeats the boundary
responsibilities.LP-9: final deployment-representative catalogue run and bounded completion claim

before.statement: New chokepoints and relevant money routines are owned by narrow no-login roles with only the grants and helpers they need; the application login cannot assume them.
